notes: First-pass sense proposal (not approved): lively / energized / 精神焕发、有活力. Do not translate as simply biologically alive; differentiate energized from excited.

First-pass sense proposal (not approved): emotionally stirred / excited (context required) / 情绪被激起（须辨别语境）. Strong semantic ambiguity, including adult senses. Hold for manual decision; never auto-publish child-facing word.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): out of breath or holding one's breath with excitement / 喘不过气来；激动得屏住呼吸. Disambiguate literal physical state versus figurative emotional state.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): too pleased with how things are to notice a problem / 自满、安于现状. Do not equate with healthy satisfaction or confidence.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): caring about someone / being worried / 关心（needs met）；担忧（needs unmet）. Two context-dependent senses; use distinct stable concept IDs before publication.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): calm or emotionally distant, depending on context / 镇定、冷静；冷淡、不在乎. Never treat slang 'cool=酷' as the emotion sense without context.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): wanting to discover or learn / 好奇. Explore rather than judging curiosity as disobedience.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): giving help to others / 乐于助人、有帮助的. Not primarily an emotion; may be related-concept or excluded from emotion browsing.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): energized and excited / tense and nervous / 兴奋得停不下来；紧绷、神经紧张. Possible positive excitement vs uneasy tension; sense separation required.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): emotionally full / overloaded by demands / 激动得不知所措；压力太大、招架不住. Separate being moved to tears with joy from being overburdened.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): pleased about effort or achievement / 自豪. Celebrate perseverance, not superiority over peers.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): responsive to emotions / easily hurt / 敏感、易受触动. Trait not necessarily emotion; distinguish gentle sensitivity from vulnerability.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): unexpectedness, positive or unpleasant / 惊讶、意外. Surprise can be positive, negative or neutral; taxonomy depends on sense/example.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): deeply distressed / 极其痛苦、备受煎熬. Use a gentle, age-appropriate real-life scene; avoid graphic distress.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): a little angry or bothered / 恼火、烦躁. Usually less intense than furious; avoid representing as explosive rage.

First-pass sense proposal (not approved): emotionally stirred / excited (context required) / 情绪被激起（须辨别语境）. Strong semantic ambiguity, including adult senses. Hold for manual decision; never auto-publish child-facing word.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): flat, uninterested, without energy / 提不起劲、没精打采. Colloquial informal; distinguish bored, apathetic and tired.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): caring about someone / being worried / 关心（needs met）；担忧（needs unmet）. Two context-dependent senses; use distinct stable concept IDs before publication.

First-pass sense proposal (not approved): feeling bad for something one has done / 内疚、愧疚. Not 'legally guilty/有罪'; avoid shaming the child.
First-pass sense proposal (not approved): physically hot or angry (context-dependent) / 热；恼火（依语境）. Unclear without context; do not automatically translate as feeling hot.
